desc: Introducing the CASCADE SR-80, a versatile, bolt-action Scout Rifle designed for short-range, fast target acquisition hunting. Whether at the range or in the field, this rifle combines comfort and speed. Crafted as CVA's version of the Scout Rifle, the SR-80 features a forward-mounted Picatinny rail for long eye relief scopes and red dots. Standard components also include Williams Gun Sights rear peep and an adjustable front sight post with built-in elevation adjustments. The SR-80’s versatile sight options assure adaptability to diverse shooting preferences. The 70-degree bolt throw enables swift action manipulation while shouldered. With a high-capacity magazine, radial muzzle brake, and adjustable length of pull with removable spacer, the SR-80 offers a tailored and affordable solution for those seeking a top-tier Scout
